title: Lab: Run and Verify a Playbook
intro_md: Exercise the daily Ansible loop: ad-hoc connectivity check, syntax check, dry run with diff, real run, and an idempotency proof.

steps.instruction_md: Verify connectivity to every host in `inventory.ini` with the ping module.
Syntax-check the playbook `site.yml` without running it.
Dry-run the playbook against the inventory, showing file diffs (check mode + diff).
steps.mock_output:
TASK [Deploy site config] ****
--- before
+++ after
+worker_processes 4;
changed: [web1]
PLAY RECAP: web1 ok=3 changed=2 (CHECK MODE)
steps.hint: --check simulates; --diff shows what templates/files would change.

steps.mock_output:
PLAY RECAP ****
web1: ok=5 changed=2 unreachable=0 failed=0
web2: ok=5 changed=2 unreachable=0 failed=0
steps.hint: Same command, minus the safety flags.

steps.instruction_md: Prove idempotency: run it again and observe changed=0.
steps.mock_output:
PLAY RECAP ****
web1: ok=5 changed=0 unreachable=0 failed=0
web2: ok=5 changed=0 unreachable=0 failed=0
steps.hint: Idempotent playbooks converge — a second run changes nothing.

steps.instruction_md: Encrypt the secrets file `group_vars/prod/vault.yml` with Ansible Vault.
